title: bunium ammoides
intro: Bunium ammoides, commonly known as the wild celery or wild lovage, is a perennial plant belonging to the family Apiaceae. It is used in traditional medicine due to its health benefits, which include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties that can help to protect against various diseases. The therapeutic actions of Bunium ammoides include its ability to stimulate digestion, relieve respiratory issues, and act as a diuretic, making it useful for treating conditions such as bronchitis and kidney stones. The bioactive constituents of this plant include volatile oils, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
